checkjs-type-check-scripts.problem: The gps and idea scripts are untyped JavaScript, so wrong option names or malformed { text, data } returns from run() are only caught by tests. A rewrite in another language was considered and rejected: the scripts are I/O-bound (performance is irrelevant), the plugin ships as plain files that run with only Node and no dependencies, and a compiled language would need per-platform binaries plus a port of the whole test suite and lib/cli.js.
checkjs-type-check-scripts.solution: Add JSDoc annotations to lib/ and the scripts, a tsconfig with checkJs and noEmit, and run tsc --checkJs --noEmit in CI. No build step, no runtime or distribution change. Open decisions: how many errors it surfaces on first run, how much annotation work that is, and whether tsc as a dev dependency fits the built-ins-only rule (it would be dev-only).
checkjs-type-check-scripts.benefits: Catches contract and option-name bugs at CI time without changing how the plugin is distributed.
checkjs-type-check-scripts.sourceDirection: Would converting the .js scripts to another language improve anything?
